asymptotic_incompleteness_mapping.description: Mapping of targets to asymptotic and measure-theoretic incompleteness domains.

mappings.notes: Depends on CSI decay sequence convergence at infinity.
Stability under unbounded recursion is symbolically supported but formally incomplete.
Requires formal measure on participation space.
Non-local interaction distance is modeled but lack a general geometric formalization.
Preserves non-uniqueness via multi-branch retention; completeness requires branching-measure formalization.
